name: Legends and Lattes
description: A general theme for any game system: cozy fantasy in coffee brown and cream with sage green, Fraunces headings, Lora text and Nunito labels, coffee cups, beans and leaf sprigs. An unofficial, fan-made look, not affiliated with or endorsed by the owners of the work or game it is named after. Legends & Lattes is a novel by Travis Baldree.
